platform: Radio K KUOM Official Digital Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: Radio K explicitly authorizes independent artists to submit a digital release to its Music Department by email using a downloadable .zip link on Google Drive, Dropbox or a similar service, preferably with lossless WAV or FLAC files; Bandcamp download codes or free-download links are also accepted. The designated email link is first-party but Cloudflare-protected and was not decoded or stored. A human must open the official page, use only the Music Department route, select a suitable MarcsMusic release, verify download permissions, include the requested concise bio/contact/similar-artist/FCC/recommended-track information, and confirm international, explicit-content and AI-origin eligibility. Do not automate the email, request tracking, decode the address, contact adjacent staff, or send Spotify-only, non-downloadable, permission-gated or expiring links.
